title: TBS Guide route and loot research

primary_source.title: Golden Sun Syndicate walkthrough
primary_source.author: ikillkenny (Golden Sun Anonymous), hosted by Golden Sun Syndicate

content_notice: Original concise factual instructions; no source prose or artwork copied. Canonical names and existing draft facts resolve noted inconsistencies.
integration_status: Loaded as an automatically selected F1 location reference through generated adventure_walkthrough_data.h. Verified detection overrides are authored in adventure_state.json; full automatic step progression remains incomplete.
coverage_notice: All 44 numbered route sections are represented, including optional backtracking and Crossbone Isle. This does not prove every chest or every detailed puzzle solution is covered.

steps.text: Follow the evacuation route north to meet Garet, then go west, climb the ladder and cross the bridge.
At the far west end, turn back southeast; warn the injured man, then return east toward the river scene.
After the rescue plan begins, go south beneath the bridge, climb back up and cross it to the Town Plaza.
Find help among the men south in the plaza, then return to Felix's riverbank.
After the boulder disaster and the forced battle, resume three years later; meet Kraden west of town.
Accept the Sol Sanctum mission, return east past your home, then approach the guarded Sanctum entrance again to proceed.
Take the right stepping stones; loop left, cross the tunnel and use the middle route in the next room.
Open the chest, use its gem on the statue, cross the far-left stones and push the marked statue.
Maze route: left, north, east, north, west, then second narrow left passage for a small gem; backtrack to skipped left hall.
Move the far-left ledge statue; place a gem in its figure and enter the right-hand door.
Skip the four-statue trap. In Sun room set corner statues on white squares, Move the center statue into light, then place right-room statues on gray squares.
Optionally take the bottom Psynergy Stone; return to Kraden and open the wall crack.
Collect two Elemental Stars, return center and save; retrieve the next. After the scene, save and follow the northwest ledge north then west for the final Star.
After the guardian returns you to Luna, use Retreat.
Return to Vale and hear the Great Healer's warning; attend the departure at the town gate to receive Catch Beads.
On the world map, approach Flint to learn about Djinn and begin the tutorial battle.
Follow the dirt path southeast to Vault.
Outside Vault, meet Hammet's caravan; learn that Ivan's rod was stolen and the group is heading north toward Lunpa.

sections.title: Vault

steps.text: Go to the northwest hilltop house, speak to Ivan and agree to help recover the stolen rod; Ivan joins you.
At the inn, question the downstairs patrons, then confront the two men upstairs; leave when they evade you and follow Ivan's plan to corner one.
After Ivan identifies the thieves, climb the inn's outside ladder, cross the roof opening and enter the hidden cellar.
Move the box blocking the cellar door, jump the gap and speak to the bound worker to trigger the bandit fight.
After the fight, recover the mayor's Precious Urn and find Hammet's rod in a chest.
Return to Ivan's house; the mayor rewards you with Water of Life. Heal at the inn before leaving.

source_issues: The page recommends a Mercury Summon in this early fight; omitted because that advice is inconsistent with the party available at this point.
Original Vault scripts identify the bound person as the roof worker; Ivan must join before accompanying the inn investigation.

sections.title: On The Road To Bilibin

steps.text: Finish Vault first; the cave route requires Ivan to join.
From Vault, go east across the bridge, then north to the cave. Climb to the leaf-covered stump; after Ivan clears it, Move the stump and use Whirlwind at the cave entrance.
Inside, follow the upper route, cross a stepping stone, descend and take the stairs and doors toward the traveler and ledge Djinn.
Push the stump between the ledges, backtrack to the water crossing, then take the southern route through doorways and stepping stones to the next stump.
Move the large stump right, cross to the southern ledge and move it left to reach the chest.
Return to the water ledge, use the stump bridge and fight Forge on the ledge.
Push the blocking stump into the water, cross it, and follow the stairs and bridge out of the cave.

source_issues: Original room27 has Lucky Medal and room28 has Power Bread; their exact placement and the sliding-stump chest association still need verification.

steps.text: Rest at the inn and check the weapon shop.
Walk the town's northeast fence logs to the western leaf-covered entrance; use Whirlwind, descend, Move the statue back and cross to Gust. No battle is needed.
Return to town and visit Lord McCoy's chambers in the northern castle. Learn where the barricade is weak, then leave toward Kolima Forest.
At the barricade, Move the far-left box to clear the route northeast.
Visit Kolima before the forest if you want its Djinn. Explore the east tree-house, use the hidden rear door and follow the basement path to Granite; no battle is needed.
Leave Kolima; its residents are transformed, and the forest remains the next story route.

sections.title: Kolima Forest

steps.text: In the forest, cross the first log path; push the blocking log west and continue north around it. On the next screen push the second blocker left and follow the northern path.
Push the next vertical log west, horizontal down, vertical east, bottom log down, horizontal up, then vertical west into water; cross and head east.
At the switch, lower the water, push the upper vertical log left, refill and cross.
Climb Tret's front vine. Work upward using outside branches; avoid jumping back onto used leaves.
Optionally touch the northern Psynergy Stone and open the Healing Ring chest.
Take the first north branch, defeat Breeze, then return for the Nut chest.
Drop one floor; reach the southern room and jump middle, right, middle to fall into the basement.
Defeat Tret, then use Retreat; seek another remedy for Kolima.

source_issues: The page states the Healing Ring restores 70 HP and wears out quickly; both mechanics are omitted pending review.
Native room45 provider102 payload300000/flag350 is a Psynergy Stone; source Psy Crystal corrected. HealingRing100F5B and Nut101F5C are ordinary item chests.

sections.title: Heading North

steps.text: At Bilibin Barricade, use Move to rescue the stranded tree-person before curing Tret; return afterward for the Hard Nut.
Return west to Bilibin to heal, then leave northwest. Cross two bridges, follow the white dirt path to Bilibin Cave and enter over the waterfall.
At the first fork go right, descend the stairs, cross the ice-cylinder room and exit near Imil; continue north and west to town.

source_issues: Hard Nut timing follows the supplied draft: rescue before the cure, reward afterward.

steps.text: In the first house, take the chest's Empty Bottle, then speak with the ill old man.
Rest at the inn, visit the church and return to the old people's home to meet Mia; follow her toward the lighthouse after the flash.
Before leaving, move the snowman left from the bridge's right-hand stairs; cross the bridge and enter the first ice opening.
Slide in this order: right, up, left, up, left, up, right, up, left, up, right, up.
Reach Fever in the ice cave; it joins without a battle. Leave town to the east for Mercury Lighthouse.

sections.title: Mercury Lighthouse

steps.text: Meet Mia; Move the statue, Ply the door, defeat Lizard Man, then Move the next statue to free Mia.
Mia brings Fizz when she joins.
Roll the first pipe right; push the discolored pipe left. Move the long-path statue to the west square.
Use Ply on the goddess; follow the water-hop route.
Defeat the chest Mimic for Water of Life; pass the third waterfall for Psynergy Armor.
In the north pipe room push both horizontal pipes up, the vertical left; cross the refilled room.
Use the pipes to shift the water statue until it drops; return and set it on the switch.
Move the statue, connect the pipe, pass the fourth waterfall and defeat Sleet.
Use Ply on the waterfall statue; after the story scene fill the Empty Bottle at the fountain for Hermes' Water.

source_issues: The page mislabels Sleet as Wind; Sleet is Mercury.
If the Empty Bottle was missed or dropped, the page points to a chest in the old people's home.

sections.title: Back to Kolima Forest

steps.text: Leave the lighthouse, return through Imil and Bilibin Cave, cross the barricade and go back to Tret in Kolima Forest.
Give Tret Hermes' Water; after the forest scene, use Retreat and return to Kolima.
Visit Lord McCoy in Bilibin. Choose one reward chest, then leave town and travel east past Kolima to the bridge; the guard now lets you cross.
McCoy's four chests are listed left to right as Vial, Potion, Psy Crystal and Water of Life.
steps.item: Vial; Potion; Psy Crystal; Water of Life

source_issues: Source misspells Vial; canonical item name used.

sections.title: Fuchin Temple

steps.text: Mind Read the temple monk, speak with him, then visit the waterfall monk.
Check barrels behind the monk for a Unicorn Ring; cross stones and enter the cave waterfall.
The entrance chest is a Mimic; take the left log route west.
Dark room: from one square below the ledge top, go right, up, right, up to the right-hand door.
Slide down; take the middle door and jump the water for Force.
Backtrack to the stone room, take the west door and lower-left stairs; ride the south vertical log to the Arctic Blade chest.
Follow logs around the west wall and spikes to the northern door; continue to the Dragon's Eye and use it on the dragon statue.
Defeat Zephyr, return to the temple and speak with the monk.

source_issues: The page is unsure whether the Dragon's Eye is required; it mislabels Zephyr as Mercury (Zephyr is Jupiter).

sections.title: Mogall Forest

steps.text: Use Force to follow the stump creature; the route can also be memorized without Force.
Use Force on the first stump. At the next, do not; push logs right, down, left, up and cross.
Follow the creature east, south, west; use Force on stumps. Move the rock into the hole, lower logs and continue.
Take the southwest grass route and defeat the Djinn before crossing onward.
At three stumps, use Force on the middle one; move the blocked log's rock into its hole, shift the log east and cross. Continue around the mini-stumps and save before the next encounter.
Follow the creature south; defeat Killer Ape and collect 1500 coins and Douse Drop. Exit south, then cross east to Xian.

source_issues: Unnamed forest Djinni identified as Quartz using the supplied draft.

sections.title: Xian

steps.text: Without Force, skip the optional log at Master Feizhi's temple; the page says it does not block progress.
Heal at the inn. To reach the eastern cliff Djinn, bring Frost; guide the wandering girl to one tile below and one tile left of the top-right corner, freeze the pillar, then cross to the cliff.
Collect Mist without a battle, then enter the nearby building on the cliff.
Stand beside the outlined stump without touching its line and use Force to open the door; speak with Feizhi and her father.
After the conversation, visit the northwest weapon shop and leave town.

source_issues: The source's NPC-position instruction for reaching Mist is unusually specific; preserve its stated tile offset, but verify in-game if it fails.

steps.text: From Xian, go north across the forest and bridges to the small island.
Win the random encounter to recruit Corona, the Mars Djinni.
Return south past the forest, then cross northwest to Alpine Crossing and continue north to Altin.
Move the statue west of town with Move and enter the cave.
Open the cave chest.
Rest at the inn, descend the ladder outside, and follow the Water Monster into the cave.
Follow it through the cave and challenge the Living Statue after sliding down the cliff.
Take the reward, then use Frost on the puddle below and cross the new ice pillar to leave.
In eastern Altin, descend the two ladders into the mine.

sections.title: Altin Peak

steps.text: Follow the mine tracks, switch the route east of the first cart, and ride to the Living Statue.
Defeat it and collect its reward.
Freeze cave puddles to make pillars; use switches and carts to reach the statue by the lake and the Djinni ledge.
Move the stump left, use Frost on the puddle, switch the cart route and ride to Spritz; defeat it.
At the falling-rock sign, face the stump and use Force; descend through the opened track and hole.
Defeat Hydros Statue, collect the Lifting Gem from its chest and use Lift to clear the exit boulder.
Revisit the earlier Lift-blocked mine chest after obtaining Lift, then leave for Lama Temple.

source_issues: The source misspells Spritz; cart-junction instructions remain condensed.

steps.text: Visit the northwestern temple and speak with Master Hama to learn Reveal.
Jump the stream east of town and cast Reveal to uncover a chest.
Open the revealed chest.
Go east to Alpine Crossing; use Reveal on the apparent dead end to find a hidden door, then Lift the rock trapping Hsu.
After freeing Hsu, return to Lama Temple and leave southwest toward the desert.

sections.title: Lamakan Desert

steps.text: Use Reveal on safe stone circles to find water pools; avoid suspicious circles until revealed because some trigger traps.
Search the southern stones on the open screen.
At the eastern wall, go one stone group south and return west to the half-circle formation for Smog.
Cross the sandfalls, then Reveal the dead-end waterfall to find the cave passage.
Reveal the waterfall beyond the cave to expose Manticore; after the battle, pass through the hidden route.
Collect the boss reward.
On the island north of the desert, win the random encounter for Vine.

source_issues: The page describes the first desert water point as a pool and later calls another a water hole; it does not clearly distinguish them.

steps.text: Upgrade equipment, then climb to Hammet's castle; Ivan can persuade the guards to admit you.
Speak with Lady Lana, then talk to everyone across every floor of the inn before leaving town.
After the tourist scene, cross the repaired bridge north of Kalay and continue back to Vault.

sections.title: Vault... Again

steps.text: Ring the tower bell to move the Djinni east, then Reveal the ladder among the graves near the dog.
The entrance chest is a Mimic; prepare for combat if opening it.
Move the torch onto the flame tile; Whirlwind the leaves, then use Frost on every water drop except the easternmost and cross the ice pillars.
Flip the water switch, then light the second flame tile to open the gate; continue down the newly drained ladder.
Climb from the lower room to reach Sap without a battle.
Use Retreat to return to the cave entrance and leave Vault.

source_issues: The chest beyond the Whirlwind door is described only as an attack-boosting item; the page does not name it.

sections.title: Bilibin Cave... Again

steps.text: From the normal entrance, Douse the fire off the ice pillars; leave and enter again through the alternate entrance beyond the vine.
Near the open chest, Reveal the suspicious stones to expose a door; Douse the fire in the next room.
Return to the ice pillars, jump onto the western ledge and collect the items in the room beyond.
steps.item: Water of Life and Psy Crystal

steps.text: If you revisit the lighthouse, collect the extra Hermes' Water mentioned by the guide.
Return west to Vale.

source_issues: The page says Herme's Water can be obtained again but gives no route or trigger details.

steps.text: Use Whirlwind on the bush behind Vale's shop and enter the cave for the chest.
From Vault, return west to Vale; Lift the rock by the western fence and Reveal the hidden stepping stone in the cave.
Push the box into the water, roll the log east, then lower the side logs and slide down the western notch to move the cross-log north.
After the ladder north of the door, open the chest before approaching the Djinni.
Chase the fleeing Djinni down the cliff, use Halt, and approach it.
Return to Kalay Docks by the southern route around the caves.

sections.title: Kalay Docks

steps.text: Buy the Tolbi ticket at the north building's counter for 600 coins, then board at the western docks.
steps.evidence_note: Original ticket callback rom_7c6bac851C compares/deducts600;15 original choice/funds cases, verify_kalay_ship.py. Source walkthrough800 corrected.

steps.text: Find the Captain's Anchor Charm on the ship's observation deck and return it to the captain below.
Reach the crew quarters behind the tour guide and descend the hidden stairs to start the voyage.
After each of the first three attacks, replace the fallen rower upstairs before sailing again.
For the optional early Crossbone Island route, choose passengers in this order: green-skirted woman, blonde woman, older man, then the merchant away from the stairs; put weaker rowers on the right.
After the fourth sea attack, return to the deck and defeat Kraken; the ship then reaches Tolbi.
Collect the victory reward.

source_issues: The source misspells Kraken as 'Krarken' in an inserted note and later mistakenly says 'Kraden'; the encounter is Kraken.

sections.title: Tolbi Docks

steps.text: Move the northwestern boxes into a jump path from the ledge by the house to the lower ledge.
Jump across the boxes and climb to the chest.
Leave the docks and enter Tolbi.

source_issues: The page gives no box-by-box order for the dock puzzle.

sections.title: Tolbi

steps.text: Buy equipment in the southwest shop; sleep in Babi's palace by speaking to the desk attendant and facing a bed.
Optional: spend Lucky Medals at the fountain for variable equipment prizes.
Use tickets at the northeast inn slot machine; rewards depend on the rings and stops.
Leave through the south gate but stay by the cliff; circle around to the vine, Use Growth on it, Use Frost on the pool, then return inside and cross the ice pillar.
Take Ember beyond the ice pillar without a battle.
Leave Tolbi and head toward Altmiller Cave.

source_issues: The fountain and slot-machine rewards are variable; the page lists odds, not a guaranteed prize.

steps.text: From Tolbi, follow the northwest dirt road and cross the western bridge.
Search the forested area for a random encounter and recruit Hail.
Return northeast across the bridge, follow the coast east to northern Kalay Docks, then walk down to Ground.
Take Ground without a battle, then return north and cross the bridge into the cave area.

sections.title: Altmiller Cave

steps.text: Use Reveal for light in dark passages; at the first rock blockage, go left, up one tile, right, then up the stairs.
Find the invisible man Babi and learn that he needs Draught; continue past him into the lower caves.
For Squall, roll the vertical log right, lower horizontal log up; Frost the puddle, return vertical left, then lower both horizontal logs.
Take Squall after the log puzzle; expect a battle.
At the five colored rocks, Reveal the colors; press the leftmost then rightmost rock to show the wheel, then press the rock matching its top color three times.
Enter the revealed room for Babi's supply.
Use Reveal on the return route, give Babi the Draught, then Retreat and travel southwest to Tolbi.

source_issues: The color-wheel instruction is described informally; it does not state a color sequence beyond matching the top color.

sections.title: Colosso

steps.text: Rest at the palace and enter the stadium. For course one, position Garet, Mia and Ivan at successive stages; give Ivan Growth.
Before round one, have Garet move the stump left and Ivan grow the vine; with Isaac, cross the gap, move the blocking stump, push the pipe west, and climb the vine.
Search the north path and log section; the guide names a Nut and an Iron Shield among the prizes.
For round two, have Mia freeze the western puddle; collect the Nut chest, cross the ice pillar, climb the wall, and shift each log left then right.
For the final round, use Garet's Move, Mia's Frost, and Ivan's Halt if available; avoid the optional chest, cross the moving pillars, then push the three logs up and the vertical log into the water.
Win all three duels. Speak with Babi for the Lure Cap, then collect Cloak Ball from his desk.
Take Babi's requested gear.

source_issues: Some course chests are unnamed; verify prize labels and unclear log directions.

steps.text: Reach Gondowan Cave, lift the rock, and take the cave route toward Lunpa.
Check the cave chests.
Move the log and tree to clear the path; Use Frost on the puddle beneath Lunpa's gate.
Pass Kalay and Vault, then enter Lunpa through the cave.
Bring Cloak Ball from Babi's desk and Catch Beads before entering the fortress.
At the north gate, Reveal the rock, Use Frost on the puddle, and hop across before Reveal fades; search the sparkle for the entrance.
Search the hidden area.
steps.item: Water of Life; Smoke Bomb; Lucky Medal; Antidote; 44 Coins; Elixir; Psynergy Stone

steps.text: Use Cloak to slip into the fortress. Evade guards, Catch the cell key through the bars, then use Whirlwind and Reveal to find the hidden door.
Open the long-box room chest.
Defeat Toadonpa, take the Psy Crystal and finish Hammet's rescue. Decline Bunza's wagon; re-enter the fortress and visit Donpa.
Speak with Donpa to open the room behind his wife; collect Tonic without a battle.

sections.title: Kalay... Again

steps.text: Rest in Kalay and speak with Bunza.
Optional: search the castle's west hall.
Take the eastern secret route. Move a statue to block the waterfall, Use Frost on the drop, and collect the Spirit Gloves; block the next waterfall to reach Scorch.
After draining the waterfall, climb down and across to collect Scorch without fighting.
Backtrack through Gondowan Cave, then rest in Tolbi.

source_issues: Four tunnel chests are mentioned but their contents are unnamed.

steps.text: Cross the southern bridge from Tolbi and head southeast to Suhalla.
Visit the red-roofed house southwest of town and speak with Iodem about water and sandstorms.
Enter Suhalla Desert; Sheba is missing, and the lighthouse route is blocked by enemies and Saturos.
Bring Douse Drop and equip Douse; Reveal footprints for route clues.
Follow the first storm west, then south. Douse it and defeat the Tornado Lizard; choose the far-east path at the first fork, then the middle path at the next.
Follow the long north passage. On the western ledge, Reveal the stump beyond the ladder to reach Flash.
Fight the Djinni on the ledge.
Continue east and save. Douse the giant southern storm and defeat Storm Lizard; take the southern Psynergy Stone, then exit east to Suhalla Gate.
Take the stone south of the storm route.
Heal with the minister beyond the north gate.
Slide down the first slope, then climb back up.
At the slide cluster, take the third slope from the left to meet Dew; then climb east and leave northeast toward Venus Lighthouse.
Fight the Djinni on the slide route.
The eastern cave leads to the ship; the walkthrough says it can wait.
Reveal the tree-floor door, descend and open the Carry Stone chest; equip it for Carry.
Return north, take the east branch and cross the stepping stones to the Lucky Cap chest.
Take Carry Stone from the hidden entrance room.
On the west branch, Carry the block, Reveal the hidden stairs beyond the electricity, and inspect the statue's tile pattern. Retreat when ready.
Return to the world map and go north, then west, toward Lalivero.
Rest at the northwest inn and shop southeast.
Search the northeast rooftop jar.
Hop across the rooftops and climb the vine to reach Torch.
Reach the southwest rooftop gate, then climb its vine.
Leave town north for Babi's Lighthouse.
First inspect the Venus statue route in Venus Lighthouse, Part 1.
Follow the orange logs north. Descend ladders and move pillars to open the way; Use Growth on a vine and descend the crevice.
Fight the Djinni in the crevice route.
South of the three-crevice room, take the first crevice to Reveal a hidden door. After Iodem leaves, continue to Temple Ruins; ignore the statue.
Solve the pillar pattern, then follow the statue's Venus Lighthouse pattern to step across.

sections.title: Venus Lighthouse, Part 2

steps.text: Explore the west branch: move pillars, Whirlwind plants, and Carry blocks. Reveal the hidden room for Oracle's Robe.
Search the hidden room.
Take the south branch. Use Douse and Frost on pillars; set statues Red/Blue at top, Gold in the center, Green/Violet below. Take the Psynergy Stone.
Take the stone beyond the statue puzzle.
Carry blocks and solve the sandfall and current routes; reveal the waterfall switch. Search the hidden room for Asura's Armor and take Dragon Scales.
Collect the named gear along the south route.
The source's later current-puzzle solution depends on a missing diagram. Reach the floating elevator and do not descend until ready; make a separate save before the final battle.

source_issues: A later current-puzzle diagram is linked from an unavailable external image; those exact steps are omitted.

steps.text: Retreat from Venus Lighthouse to Suhalla Desert; Carry is needed for Crossbone Island.
Save separately in the desert if you want a return point.
Reveal the stump, cross to the cave, and take its northeast route. Enter the pink tornado without Dousing it to reach Crossbone Island.

sections.title: Crossbone Island

steps.text: Growth twice; Whirlwind the left-slide shrub. Check middle/right slide chests.
Floor 1.
steps.item: 111 Coins; Nut; Hard Nut; Antidote; Lucky Medal

steps.text: Floor 2.
steps.item: Elixir; 222 Coins; Lucky Pepper; Mystery Blade

steps.text: Floor 3: Catch Smoke Bomb; Reveal gem; red exit.
steps.item: 333 Coins; Fairy Ring; Cookie; Smoke Bomb; Psy Crystal

steps.text: Floor 4.
steps.item: 444 Coins; Sleep Bomb; Storm Gear; Psy Crystal

steps.text: Floor 5.
steps.item: 555 Coins; Lucky Medal; Ninja Garb; Potion

steps.text: Floor 6: freeze puddle and Halt Bane.
Floor 6.
steps.item: Elixir; 666 Coins; Demon Axe; Water of Life; Bane (Venus Djinni)

steps.text: Floor 7; Carry blocks.
steps.item: Lucky Medal; Psy Crystal; Wicked Mace; 777 Coins; Water of Life

steps.text: Floor 8: use Frost; let dragon melt ice pillar before freezing platform puddle.
Floor 8.
steps.item: Smoke Bomb; 888 Coins; Cleric's Ring; Potion

steps.text: Floor 9; follow moving logs.
steps.item: 999 Coins; Sleep Bomb; Water of Life; Muramasa; Psy Crystal

steps.text: Floor 10 west dock has a mimic. Defeat Deadbeard; Demon Mail is cursed.
Boss rewards.
steps.item: 8,000 XP; 9,000 Coins; Water of Life; Demon Mail

source_issues: Numbering follows source puzzle floors. Chest routes are condensed; not exhaustive.

steps.text: Retrace the Part 2 lighthouse puzzles. At the top, heal, save separately, take the Psy Crystal, and descend the crevice when ready.
Take the top-floor crystal.
Defeat Saturos and Menardi, then the Fusion Dragon. Watch the beacon and Sheba's ending scenes.
In Lalivero, speak with Iodem to receive the Black Orb.
Go to the guarded northwest building and continue to the northern dock.
Use the Black Orb to raise the ship; the ending leads into The Lost Age.
